purpose: Validate and declare the root Message entity profile with three distinct evidence roles and two exact relations while explicitly excluding protocol, transport, and execution semantics.

required.statement: Accept exactly objects TLC-SO-MESSAGE-001, TLC-SO-MESSAGE-004, and TLC-SO-MESSAGE-030 as distinct evidence identities.
Accept exactly relations TLC-SR-MESSAGE-003 and TLC-SR-MESSAGE-029 with their authoritative endpoints.
Return distinct entity, essential_properties, and transmissibility roles with both relation identities preserved.
Preserve opaque evidence, source references, candidate status, provenance, unresolved identifiers TLC-UT-MESSAGE-001 and TLC-UT-MESSAGE-021, and reservation TLC-DUP-MESSAGE-001.

forbidden.statement: Do not accept or expose encoding, transport, execution, sender, recipient, channel, delivery, or protocol fields.
Do not infer property classifications, transmission mechanics, audience, medium, truth, or scientific capability.
Do not merge roles, objects, relations, or relation endpoints.
Do not expose a successful partial profile after any validation or preservation failure.

deferred.statement: Property classifications, transmission mechanics, audience, medium, encoding, transport, and execution remain preserved unresolved or external.
Concrete representation, ownership, storage, concurrency, and serialization remain implementation-defined.

operations.purpose: Construct the non-executable root Message profile from exact object and relation evidence.

inputs.name: message_declaration_evidence
inputs.semantic_role: exact root entity, property, and transmissibility evidence with relations

constraints.statement: The exact three object and two relation identities occur once and remain distinct.
Both relations retain their authoritative evidence endpoints.
No protocol, encoding, transport, execution, sender, recipient, channel, or delivery field is present.

fields.name: relations
fields.semantic_role: both exact relation identities and endpoints

constraints.statement: entity, essential_properties, and transmissibility are distinct required references.
Both relation identities and authoritative endpoints are preserved.
No protocol, encoding, transport, execution, sender, recipient, channel, or delivery field exists.
Opaque content, candidate status, provenance, unresolved identifiers, and reservation remain unchanged.

preconditions.statement: The exact three objects and two relations are supplied unchanged and without duplicates.
Both relations have authoritative endpoints and no forbidden protocol field is present.

postconditions.statement: The profile exposes three distinct evidence roles and preserves both relation identities and endpoints.
No encoding, transport, execution, sender, recipient, channel, delivery, or protocol interface is present.
All unresolved, reservation, provenance, opaque content, and candidate status remain observable.

invariants.statement: Object identity, relation identity, endpoints, role separation, opaque content, provenance, candidate status, and unresolved state are conserved.
No protocol, transport, scientific evaluation, execution, or external state mutation occurs.

prescription_basis: Exact identities, endpoints, prohibited-field rejection, role separation, preservation, and failure-before-success are observable. Internal construction order is otherwise open.

error_contract.condition: A required object, relation, or source reference is missing, duplicated, or replaced.
A required relation does not retain its authoritative evidence endpoints.
Protocol, encoding, transport, execution, sender, recipient, channel, or delivery data is supplied or produced.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the exact three-role, two-relation non-executable profile.
Do not expose encoding, transport, delivery, sender, recipient, or channel behavior.
Do not infer property classifications, transmission mechanics, audience, medium, truth, or execution capability.
Internal representation and relation-validation architecture are free when all observable obligations remain satisfied.

global_invariants.statement: The exact three objects, two relations, two unresolved identifiers, and TLC-DUP-MESSAGE-001 remain complete and distinct.
The documentary transmissibility role never implies a transport protocol or executable capability.

dependencies.purpose: Lossless object, relation, endpoint, and source references.
Exact object and relation population semantics.

notes: This feature is the documentary dependency root for the other Message packages; no runtime execution dependency is implied.
